description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the ProviderAPI class within the OpenID Authentication plugin of the OrangeHRM system. It contains various test methods for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting provider API entities, using data providers and mocking services.

classes.name: ProviderAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the ProviderAPI endpoints in the OpenID Authentication plugin, covering create, get, update, and delete operations.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests the creation of a provider via the ProviderAPI using a data provider.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestCreate
methods.description: Provides test cases data for testing the create operation.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieving a single provider entity via the ProviderAPI.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetOne
methods.description: Provides test cases data for testing the getOne operation.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test cases data for testing the getAll operation.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests deleting a provider via the ProviderAPI.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestDelete
methods.description: Provides test cases data for testing the delete operation.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestUpdate
methods.description: Provides test cases data for testing the update operation.
